name: Kanan (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kanan town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised letter Y with two discs.
history: Municipal flag of Kanan, a town in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 January 1957.

features.role: Kanan town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised letter Y with two discs
